system.biography:
Background

Formerly the Black Prince of Cornwall, Embraced in 1432 and betrayed by his own sire, Sir Lorence, who murdered Scott's mortal wife and son as part of the Embrace, Edward Scott fled to the New World and eventually settled in Milwaukee, where he now sits on the city's ruling Council as the self-appointed "Prince of the Anarchs." He deliberately courts scandal — attending Council meetings in a bathrobe or bikini — to bait the Elders and remind them of the vitality he believes their "soft and fat" ancient wisdom has lost. He sired the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.ZFYurbvAHfaRguYI]{Brujah} elder Akawa (whom he does not remember Embracing) and maintains an intense, decades-long friendly rivalry with him; the two have nearly killed each other in the dueling grounds on multiple occasions, always without a clear winner, and Scott has saved Akawa from a Blood Hunt more than once. Scott has significant, if informal, influence over both major Anarch gangs, the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.antitribu.JournalEntry.hs33xrNXWT2UXXS4]{Blood Brothers} and the Union, and personally challenges any Elder (such as Gracis Nostinus) who threatens to move against the Anarchs over a Masquerade breach.

Roleplaying Hints

Smile constantly, mock everyone (Elders, Anarchs, mortals, and himself), never show real anger, and compliment every woman present regardless of context. Underneath the theatrical rebel is genuine centuries-old grief and rage at how Elders prey on the young and weak.
system.notes: Sire: Sir Lorence (who killed Scott's mortal family as part of the Embrace). Haven: a small, elegant apartment on Milwaukee's east side near the lake. Disciplines as printed: Auspex 1, Celerity 3, Fortitude 2, Potence 4, Presence 6 (capped to this system's 1-5 scale above; restore book values at Storyteller discretion for high-power scenes).

vtmlarp.source: Milwaukee by Night, Chapter Three: The Kindred
